verdict.rationale: Airbyte's sync-schedules docs explicitly state connections can be run on three options — cron expressions, scheduled cadence, or manual triggers — which directly matches the story's requirement for flexible per-pipeline scheduling, and this is reinforced by API/Terraform docs enabling programmatic control of scheduling. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of true sub-hour minimum interval limits or independent hands-on confirmation of scheduling granularity in production.
